messages.subject: shiny app to link to other apps on shiny server
parts:
Hey Everyone-

I am trying to create a shiny app that will serve as a homepage when users navigate to my shiny server but haven't been able to figure it out. I have all of my shiny apps in their own directory,

srv/shiny-server/apps/, and when I place the homepage app (or even an index.Rmd file) in srv/shiny-server/ it will render but is unable to locate the other apps. I tried altering the location settings of the shiny-server.conf file but nothing has worked so far. Can someone please point me in the right direction? Thanks!

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: shiny app to link to other apps on shiny server
parts:
Hi, please paste the index.html code here. 

I have done something similar. There are two methods: 
1. index.html. You can create one or several iframes, whose source is the url of your app.
2. create an shiny app, simply just include one selectbox and a HTML output. the HTML output is a iframe, whose source react on the selected value of the selected box (your app URL).
